Title: The 3-Part Email Prompt That Never Sounds Robotic
Summary: Stop getting stiff replies. Give AI your role, context, and two real examples of how you write.
Prompt Template:
Role: I'm [your role] writing to [who] about [topic].
Context: [what happened, what I need from them, anything that must not change]
My style: here are two emails I wrote that sound like me:
[example 1]
[example 2]

Write a reply in my voice, under 120 words, warm and direct. No buzzwords.

Title: Turn a Messy Fridge Photo Into a 4-Day Dinner Plan
Summary: Snap a quick photo of what is in your kitchen and get a practical meal plan plus a grouped shopping list.
Prompt Template:
[Attach a photo of your fridge and pantry]
We're [number] people. We like: [foods]. We avoid: [allergies or dislikes].

List what you can see, then plan 4 dinners that use it up first, each under 40 minutes. Finish with one shopping list grouped by supermarket section.

Title: Meeting Transcript to Action Table in 15 Seconds
Summary: A copy-and-paste instruction that extracts decisions, owners, and open questions from any call transcript.
Prompt Template:
Here's a meeting transcript (names and numbers removed where sensitive):
[paste transcript]

Make a table with three parts: 1) decisions made, 2) action items with owner and due date, 3) open questions. Only use what's in the transcript. If an owner or date is missing, write "not stated".

Title: How to Spot When AI Is Guessing
Summary: Three verification prompts to keep AI honest when summarizing PDFs or comparing quotes.
Prompt Template:
1) For each claim in your answer, quote the exact sentence from my file that supports it. If you can't find one, say so.
2) Which parts of your answer are you least sure about, and why?
3) What would change your answer? List the facts I should double-check myself before acting.

Title: Creating Clean Presentation Visuals Without Weird Text
Summary: Get slide-ready images by leaving the words out of the picture and adding your headline in the slide instead.
Prompt Template:
Create an image for a presentation slide about [topic].
Style: [for example: clean flat illustration, warm editorial photo]
Colours: [for example: navy and cream with an amber accent]
Layout: wide 16:9 with empty space on the left for a headline.
Do not include any text, letters, numbers or logos in the image.
Give me 3 variations.

Title: The 5-Minute Checklist Before Automating Any Task
Summary: Before you open Zapier, Make, n8n or Power Automate, check five things: what starts it, what goes in, each step, where a person approves, and what happens if it fails.
Prompt Template:
I want to automate this task: [describe what happens today, step by step].
It happens [how often] and takes about [minutes].

Check it against 5 points: trigger, inputs, numbered steps, where a person must approve before anything is sent or deleted, and what should happen if a step fails.
Tell me what's missing, then suggest the smallest first version I could build this week.
